faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost in Trinidad and Tobago?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial offering up to 1,000,000 tokens daily, with a linked card billed only if not cancelled before the trial ends.

faq.q: How do Ceyo bots operate over Telegram?
faq.a: You can chat directly with individual agents or add multiple specialist bots to a Telegram group chat. They collaborate in real time, sharing memory and executing tasks as a coordinated digital workforce.

faq.q: What happens when my computer or phone is offline?
faq.a: Every Ceyo bot runs inside its own isolated cloud computer that operates 24/7. Scheduled routines, data extractions, and background coding tasks continue uninterrupted whether your devices are active or powered off.

faq.q: What languages and communication modes can my agents use?
faq.a: Ceyo agents support fluent English, Spanish, French, and dozens of international languages. You can interact via text, document uploads, or voice and video phone calls.

faq.q: What applications can Ceyo integrate with?
faq.a: Ceyo connects natively to over 1,000 applications, including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, calendars, and leading enterprise CRMs, alongside an integrated crypto wallet for autonomous web transactions.
